text:
Maya: Quick thread to lock down what we actually ship for console observability this quarter. Customers want cost attribution + fast error triage. Keep scope surgical.
Owen: I propose a two-track: Observable dashboards (GA target) + Tracing links (Enterprise opt-in). Dashboards get the majority of value.
Priya: Agree. For dashboards v1: per-route cost breakdown, 95/99 latency buckets, error counts + top stack snippets. No raw span browsing.
Theo: From infra POV, telemetry is a cost vector. We need a default telemetry_budget and adaptive sampling that kicks in if spend delta > 15%.
Maya: Acceptance checklist for launch (minimum):
- Cost Insights card with top 5 routes by spend and a small explainer for each
- Error Summary: grouped by route + top 3 stack excerpts and a sample link
- Telemetry budget controls in Settings and an estimate of weekly telemetry cost
Owen: UX: default to a compact card on the home console; users can open an expanded modal with trends and root-cause bullets. Non-admins see compact only.
Priya: Implementation sketch for sampling config (customer-facing YAML):
```
telemetry:
  enabled: true
  mode: adaptive
  sampling_base: 0.005
  sampling_max: 0.25
  budget_pct: 1.0
  redact_high_cardinality: true
```
Theo: Ops runbook item: if telemetry_write_ops > 2500/min and billing_estimate_delta > 12% => reduce sampling_base by 50%, notify oncall, and pause rollouts.
Maya: Rollout plan: internal dogfood (1 sprint) -> closed beta (SMB + 2 mid-market) for dashboards only -> Enterprise opt-in for trace links post-beta.
Owen: Gate for widening beta: weekly telemetry_cost_change <= +12% AND error_dashboard_latency_p95 < 600ms. If either fails, hold.
Priya: Fallback behavior: if trace pipeline fails, UI shows 'sample unavailable' and displays aggregated counts + last sample. No silent drops.
Theo: Risk: customers will request "show raw spans". Sales should have a short script: explain tracing is opt-in and include expected cost/SLAs.
Maya: Decisions: ship dashboards (cost+errors) to beta; tracing opt-in for Enterprise. Telemetry guardrails on by default.
rollout-bot: ACK  will post rollout status and set a rollback marker if telemetry_budget_exceeded during rollout.
Maya: Owners: Priya -> PRD + sample configs by Tue EOD; Owen -> mocks for compact/expanded views by Thu; Theo -> ops throttles + runbook by Fri. I'll coordinate beta customers.
Priya: I'll include the 'why is this expensive' bullets (context length, repeated re-runs, large embeddings) in the PRD.
Owen: I'll prototype the compact card with the three-line explainer and an expand CTA this sprint.
Maya: Thanks team  narrow scope + strict guardrails. :rocket:
